contradictions.claim_a: A written device procedure is itself proof that the native bridge executed.
contradictions.claim_b: A written procedure makes the lane reproducible, but only a target-host response and denial receipt prove execution.
contradictions.audit_trail: The prior BDD wording was corrected because it asserted invocation while checking only documentation metadata.

contradictions.claim_a: Completing the bounded source implementation authorizes stable publication.
contradictions.claim_b: Implementation, evidence, certification, and publication are independent fail-closed dimensions.
